name: Alex Johnson
bio:
Alex Johnson is a seasoned business strategist with over 15 years of experience in helping organizations transform their operations and achieve sustainable growth. With a proven track record of delivering innovative solutions across various industries, Alex specializes in strategic planning, organizational development, and change management.

Prior to joining Code Collider, Alex led strategic initiatives at Fortune 500 companies, where they successfully implemented large-scale transformation programs that resulted in significant cost savings and revenue growth. Alex holds an MBA from Stanford University and is a certified Project Management Professional (PMP).

When not developing strategic roadmaps, Alex enjoys mentoring young professionals and speaking at industry conferences about the future of business strategy in the digital age.
